HediffDef.label: recent Goa'uld implantation
HediffDef.description: An adult Goa'uld symbiote has recently entered this host and is attaching itself to the nervous system. The victim suffers a painful critical phase while the parasite attempts to establish control. After one in-game day, the same persistent symbiote identity automatically moves into the active Goa'uld host state.
